CHAPTER.VERS: A Song of Ascents. I will lift up my eyes to the mountains: From where will my help come?
My help [comes] from Yahweh, Who made heaven and earth.
He will not allow your foot to be moved: He who keeps you will not slumber.
Look, he who keeps Israel Will neither slumber nor sleep.
Yahweh is your keeper: Yahweh is your shade on your right hand.
The sun will not strike you by day, Nor the moon by night.
Yahweh will keep you from all evil; He will keep your soul.
Yahweh will keep your going out and your coming in From this time forth and forevermore.
